checked_obligation: Under the forward-implication assumption that a is a primitive root modulo p=4t+3, verify that (-a)^((p-1)/2) is congruent to 1 modulo p.
reason: Since (p-1)/2=2t+1 is odd, (-1)^((p-1)/2)=-1. By the closed predecessor n2, a^((p-1)/2) is congruent to -1 modulo p. Therefore (-a)^((p-1)/2)=(-1)^((p-1)/2)a^((p-1)/2) is congruent to (-1)(-1)=1 modulo p. No candidate external theorem is needed.
